function.arguments: {"observation": "The analyst removed all rows where biomarker_baseline == -999 before counting patients. If a patient had only one assay and that assay failed QC (i.e., biomarker_baseline == -999), they would be excluded from the enrollment count, even though they were enrolled in the trial. This risks undercounting the true number of enrolled patients.", "implication": "The current method of counting patients — removing rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 before deduplication — may exclude patients who were enrolled but had no valid baseline measurement. To correctly count enrolled patients, we must count all patients who were enrolled, regardless of assay quality. The correct approach is to deduplicate first (keeping the highest sample_seq per patient_id), then remove rows with biomarker_baseline == -999. This ensures that every enrolled patient is counted once, even if their only assay failed QC."}
function.name: note_finding
